races.name: Try Unibet's New Improved Acca Boosts Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
SUPERSTORM races off the same mark as when narrowly denied at Brighton last Monday. Musical Soldier would be a major threat if turning up after/instead of Lingfield on Tuesday. Orange Emperor is next on the list.

  1. SUPERSTORM
  2. MUSICAL SOLDIER (IRE)
  3. ORANGE EMPEROR (IRE)

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GOLD ARMY is the percentage call on the back of his promising first run over C&D last month but strong market support for well bred and expensively purchased newcomers Inscription, Anahona and Amo Racing duo Abersoch and Le Drakkar would put a slightly different slant on things.

  1. GOLD ARMY
  2. INSCRIPTION (IRE)
  3. ANAHONA (USA)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SIERRA BELLE is given a second chance to fully confirm her debut promise. Farasan left the impression his debut was needed and can leave that form behind and provide the chief threat ahead of last week's Brighton third I Am Royal.

  1. SIERRA BELLE
  2. FARASAN
  3. I AM ROYAL (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
FORTITUDINE and Shadow Road won C&D novices on the same card 4 weeks ago. The latter had something to spare and looks useful but Godolphin's charge scored by a margin rarely seen in these sort of races and is likely to make it 2-2.

  1. FORTITUDINE (IRE)
  2. SHADOW ROAD (IRE)
  3. BRAVE HUNTER

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
GOT THE BOOTY has shown her best form on all-weather and might be worth chancing to make a winning start for new trainer Clive Cox, with confidence in her chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Billy Loughnane takes the reins on Zoustar Dreams who is second choice ahead of Amelia's Joy.

  1. GOT THE BOOTY (FR)
  2. ZOUSTAR DREAMS
  3. AMELIA'S JOY

races.name: Unibet Supporting Safer Gambling Handicap
races.verdict:
BLAKEFELL has been shaping up well and may prove the answer if over his exertions at Musselburgh last week. Comic Hero remains unexposed and is feared most back at the scene of his novice win at the start of the year. Shaman Champion took a big step back in the right direction at Southwell last time and is next on the list.

  1. BLAKEFELL (IRE)
  2. COMIC HERO (IRE)
  3. SHAMAN CHAMPION (IRE)

races.name: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
races.verdict:
MADJID has been an improved performer since front-running tactics have been employed and should prove tough to beat on the hat-trick bid. Joseph might be the one to give him most to do.

  1. MADJID
  2. JOSEPH
  3. EXTRATERRESTRIAL (IRE)

races.name: Heineken Low & No Bar EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SOD HALL LANE ran to a fairly useful level when finishing runner-up at Musselburgh on debut last month and a repeat effort should be enough to see Declan Carroll's colt go one better. He gets the nod over Royal Strike, who showed more than first time up when third at Thirsk recently and he's open to further improvement. Bacha completes the shortlist.

  1. SOD HALL LANE (IRE)
  2. ROYAL STRIKE (IRE)
  3. BACHA (IRE)

races.name: Hampton By Hilton Hotel Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks wide open and with that in mind a chance is taken on IMPRESSOR. Phil Makin's 9-y-o wasn't at his best in a first-time visor here 12 days ago but the refitting of cheekpieces/return to soft ground are both likely catalysts for a better showing and he could well be ready to capitalise on a much-reduced mark. Big Apple Jack is a danger following his recent Carlisle second, with last year's runner-up Lumenbourg and course specialist Iris Dancer others fancied to feature.

  1. IMPRESSOR (IRE)
  2. BIG APPLE JACK
  3. LUMENBOURG

races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
A match on paper between last year's winner PERSEUS WAY and Clocker, with preference for the former having completed a cross-code hat-trick this summer. Back from a break, he can get the better of Ed Bethell's 3-y-o filly, who has won 2 of her last 3 starts and is heading in the right direction. Ebony Maw looks best of the rest.

  1. PERSEUS WAY (IRE)
  2. CLOCKER
  3. EBONY MAW

races.name: Molton Brown Luxury Fragrance Hamilton Park 2-Y-O Series Final Nursery
races.verdict:
Preference is for BATTLE FEVER, who ran a cracker in a valuable sales race at York when proving no match for a recent Group 1 winner and Kevin Ryan's colt is fancied to kick on now tackling a nursery for the first time. Harley got off the mark when comfortably accounting for Sea Mirage over C&D last month and that pair can give the selection most to think about here.

  1. BATTLE FEVER (IRE)
  2. HARLEY (IRE)
  3. SEA MIRAGE (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On X At HamiltonParkRC Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
MAE AMOR has put together a couple of solid runs in recent weeks and returning to the scene of her 66/1-shock win back in the spring, Rebecca Menzies' 4-y-o gets the verdict over Diamont Katie, who did enough to suggest she's still in form when mid-field at Glorious Goodwood last time and drops in grade here. Thunderstorm Katie and Invincible Ruby can fight out minor honours.

  1. MAE AMOR (IRE)
  2. DIAMONT KATIE (IRE)
  3. THUNDERSTORM KATIE

races.name: CleanStay At Hampton By Hilton Handicap
races.verdict:
TEE AITCH AYE has confirmed himself back in form with a couple of placed efforts at Ayr in recent weeks and remaining 5 lb below the mark he defied here last September, Iain Jardine's 5-y-o gets the nod to double his tally. Jim Goldie sends out 3 and his Yaaser looks most interesting having his first start in a 0-60 since 2022, with Palmarian another worth considering, too.

  1. TEE AITCH AYE (IRE)
  2. YAASER (IRE)
  3. PALMARIAN

races.name: Book Your Christmas Party Hamilton Park Handicap
races.verdict:
A winner over C&D in June, ANNANDALE arrives having run well when second at Carlisle 6 days ago, staying on well to split a pair of 3-y-os. A repeat gives him sound claims from the same mark. Easy Musselburgh scorer Sophiesticate and in-form Dubai Venture are others fancied to be in the thick of things, whilst market confidence behind the returning Vampire Slayer would also look significant.

  1. ANNANDALE (IRE)
  2. SOPHIESTICATE (IRE)
  3. DUBAI VENTURE (IRE)

races.name: Border Minstrel Pub Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Having been placed on all 4 starts this season, KOKO BLUE is selected to open her account having paid for racing closest to the winner when third at Lingfield last month. Love You More's achilles' heel is her slow starts, but she can give the selection most to think about if on a going day, with Millbuie rounding off the shortlist.

  1. KOKO BLUE
  2. LOVE YOU MORE
  3. MILLBUIE

races.name: Mini Golf At High Gosforth Park Handicap
races.verdict:
BALDOSA can quickly get back on track given more of a break this time. Dalamara won a stronger race than this at Musselburgh last week so she is the obvious threat under a penalty.

  1. BALDOSA (IRE)
  2. DALAMARA
  3. PAROLE OFFICER

races.name: Sunday Lunch At The Border Minstrel EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
YORDAN is potentially useful and this looks an excellent opportunity for him to defy a penalty. Brash and Ennoble can battle for the minor honours.

  1. YORDAN (IRE)
  2. BRASH (IRE)
  3. ENNOBLE (IRE)

races.name: High Gosforth Park Golf Club Handicap
races.verdict:
Competitive stuff with the vote going to BEATTIE IS BACK who looks ready to strike returned to 7f. Unexposed 3-y-o Highland Shah is another to consider along with Havana Prince and Tasever, who are back on winning marks.

  1. BEATTIE IS BACK
  2. HIGHLAND SHAH (FR)
  3. HAVANA PRINCE

races.name: Christmas Parties At Newcastle Racecourse Nursery
races.verdict:
PROFITABILITY has shown a bit more with each start and an opening mark of 59 could underestimate her. Secret Rival should prove much more competitive at this level, while Claret Time probably has a bigger performance in him.

  1. PROFITABILITY (IRE)
  2. SECRET RIVAL (IRE)
  3. CLARET TIME

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
CRIMINAL SHORE took a step back in the right direction at Doncaster last time and could be the answer returned to the all-weather having won off this mark over C&D in June. Flying Fletcher is another who is worth a second look back on this surface, while unexposed 3-y-o Bee Farmer is another interesting contender.

  1. CRIMINAL SHORE (IRE)
  2. FLYING FLETCHER
  3. BEE FARMER

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
PAPA DON'T PREACH went within a head of opening his seasonal account at Yarmouth last month so, provided he can put a lesser 6f effort behind him since, Kevin & Lauren Frost's charge gets the nod. Let's Go Hugo arrives seeking a hat-trick, so he's feared most returned to handicap company, with the Phil Kirby-trained pair Lady Bouquet and Ellie's de Vega taken to fight out third.

  1. PAPA DON'T PREACH (IRE)
  2. LET'S GO HUGO (IRE)
  3. LADY BOUQUET

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for BOOK OF LIFE to notch an overdue second success in Britain and he rates as a confident selection, with recent Southwell scorer Hear The Drums and Mercurius Power the likeliest dangers.

  1. BOOK OF LIFE
  2. HEAR THE DRUMS
  3. MERCURIUS POWER (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ITSZABOY represents a strong-looking Redcar form line and he can get off the mark here. Barleybrown is potentially well treated and remains of interest in this grade, whilst Here Comes Louie has a valid excuse for last time and would merit consideration on his prior efforts.

  1. ITSZABOY
  2. BARLEYBROWN
  3. HERE COMES LOUIE

races.name: Bath Country Race Day, What A Way To Make Weekend! EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ETIENNE has made a promising start to his career in his 2 races so far, nearest at the finish when making the frame in the Super Sprint at Newbury, so he looks to hold leading claims in maiden company. Tree Wizard could be next best on his second run for current yard, ahead of Anna Belardo.

  1. ETIENNE
  2. TREE WIZARD
  3. ANNA BELARDO

races.name: Welsh Power 20th Anniversary Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
STARSONG ran well in this grade when runner-up at Pontefract on her penultimate start and she is taken to build on that effort at the second attempt from what is a workable mark. The Feminine Urge is also well treated on last season's form and gets the vote for second, with Ken Brulee another to consider.

  1. STARSONG (IRE)
  2. THE FEMININE URGE (IRE)
  3. KEN BRULEE

races.name: Welsh Power 20th Anniversary Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Preference is for HONOUR YOUR DREAMS, who showed better signs reverting to making the running at Ffos Las on his latest outing. He is fancied to take advantage of his career-low mark this time around, at the expense of the consistent Sisters In The Sky and Rogue Rebellion.

  1. HONOUR YOUR DREAMS (FR)
  2. SISTERS IN THE SKY
  3. ROGUE REBELLION

races.name: Trusted Betting Site Reviews gambling.com Handicap
races.verdict:
Runner-up here in May, WEDGEWOOD hasn't been in the same form on her last 2 starts but she could well fare better back over this C&D. She's handily weighted based on her 10-lb higher mark on all-weather and can see off the challenge of Call Time, who arrives on the back of a promising effort. Jackie Brown completes the shortlist.

  1. WEDGEWOOD
  2. CALL TIME (IRE)
  3. JACKIE BROWN (IRE)

races.name: Bath Country Race Day, Running 9 Till 5 Handicap
races.verdict:
JUST ADAIR is fully exposed by now but is more reliable than most at this level and can score for the first time this year. Basilette and Fram Castle also arrive on the back of positive efforts and make most appeal as alternatives.

  1. JUST ADAIR
  2. BASILETTE (IRE)
  3. FRAM CASTLE (IRE)

races.name: Regal Gaming Grand Gallop Handicap
races.verdict:
BUCKLAND BELLE hasn't put a foot wrong this season and came a long way clear with one that has already followed up at Windsor last week, so makes plenty of appeal again. Course specialist Blue Hero and Galactic Glow head up the dangers.

  1. BUCKLAND BELLE
  2. BLUE HERO (CAN)
  3. GALACTIC GLOW (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
QUEBELLA made a promising reappearance at Goodwood and, with this return to further in her favour, she can make her third start for Owen Burrows a winning one. Asset remains lightly raced in handicaps for Sir Mark Prescott and is feared most, while Mythical Bird can go well in her current form.

  1. QUEBELLA
  2. ASSET (GER)
  3. MYTHICAL BIRD (IRE)

races.name: Compare Betting Sites At gambling.com Handicap
races.verdict:
The finale can go the way of BELLE AMIE, who got back on track when third at Lingfield last time despite racing closer to the pace than ideal. She can go on to land a third win of the campaign, though Shaffron has possibilities after showing better signs on her latest outing, with Offiah's Boy also in the mix.

  1. BELLE AMIE (SWE)
  2. SHAFFRON
  3. OFFIAH'S BOY

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
ANNIE BATT disappointed here last time but is well worth another chance to build on a promising debut effort behind a subsequent winner. Bit of A Buzz looks more or less exposed now but should go well again back in maiden company, with Lady Romagna narrowly preferred of the newcomers before market clues.

  1. ANNIE BATT (IRE)
  2. BIT OF A BUZZ (IRE)
  3. LADY ROMAGNA (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
PRAIRIE GIRL shaped well after a break when making the frame at the Curragh in August and she can build on that effort to resume winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Harry's Hill, who arrives on the back of a comfortable success at the Curragh, with Gotta Catch'Em All and Cuban Grey completing the shortlist.

  1. PRAIRIE GIRL (IRE)
  2. HARRY'S HILL
  3. GOTTA CATCH'EM ALL (IRE)

races.name: Kilberry (Q.R.) Handicap
races.verdict:
TIMURSHAH has thrived over hurdles for Aidan Melia and it's worth giving him a chance to show he can also translate that improvement to the Flat. Murat has made a positive start to his Flat career and is second choice ahead of Not Just Any Eagle, Cala Gracioneta and Friary Road.

  1. TIMURSHAH (IRE)
  2. MURAT (IRE)
  3. NOT JUST ANY EAGLE (IRE)

races.name: Book Your Hospitality Now For Navan Racing Festival Maiden
races.verdict:
LET'S SMASH IT has shown pretty useful form on all 4 starts and is taken to get off the mark, perhaps at the main expense of Dermot Weld's Dundalk runner-up Emiza. Chapel Lane and Elusive Path represent in-form stables and also have the form to figure.

  1. LET'S SMASH IT (IRE)
  2. EMIZA (FR)
  3. CHAPEL LANE (IRE)

races.name: Navan Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
CHOU CHOU took a notable step back in the right direction when fourth at Gowran 3 weeks ago and now operating just 1 lb above the mark he defied at Clonmel this time last year, he could well be ready to strike reunited with Colin Keane. Duchess Anne, Perfect Judgement and Concaire are just a trio of others to consider in a competitive heat.

  1. CHOU CHOU (IRE)
  2. DUCHESS ANNE (IRE)
  3. PERFECT JUDGEMENT (IRE)

races.name: Navan Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
MOYASSR's latest run in claiming company needs forgiving, yet he'd previously been shaping better than recent form figures suggest and is afforded another chance back on his last winning mark starting out for Ado McGuinness. Thompson Gunner and Micasso head up the dangers in what is a particularly trappy affair.

  1. MOYASSR (IRE)
  2. THOMPSON GUNNER (IRE)
  3. MICASSO (IRE)

races.name: Navan Racing Festival 14th & 15th November Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive, big-field handicap. DALER has been holding his form well since doubling his career tally at Leopardstown in June and looks a solid proposition off top weight. Zaraahmando, No More Porter and Anvika are all shortlisted.

  1. DALER (IRE)
  2. ZARAAHMANDO (IRE)
  3. NO MORE PORTER (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again This Saturday Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
SUNATIA was no match for the promising Star Performer at the Curragh and can go one better with the prospect of more improvement to come. Saxony Charms can go well after 3 good runs at the Curragh herself, while the well-bred Fairylike will progress.

  1. SUNATIA (FR)
  2. SAXONY CHARMS (IRE)
  3. FAIRYLIKE (USA)
